scripts.test: npm run test:boundaries && npm run test:emulator
scripts.test:boundaries: npm run build && node --test test/production-boundary.test.mjs test/development-boundary.test.mjs
scripts.test:emulator: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --config ../firebase.emulator.json --project demo-duit --only auth,firestore "node emulator/run-with-host.mjs npm run test:smoke"
scripts.emulators:start: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --config ../firebase.emulator.json --project demo-duit --only auth,firestore "node emulator/run-with-host.mjs --serve"
